recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It resolves the remaining stale definition without broadening the issue beyond the accepted code-values wording.
issue_request: FHIR-40842 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core Technical Correction requesting that the brief :code-text description stop saying it matches textual display values and instead describe standard string search against code values.
initial_application: PR 3442, represented locally by commit 2d75aa13d33fc4e852fd09b1133fe61640f35ca6, updated source/search.html so the modifier listing table no longer used the old display-text wording. That commit did not update source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml, leaving the code-text concept definition stale.
additional_context: FHIR-32673 is the supporting Published/Persuasive with Modification decision that introduced :code-text for partial text searching on the code or value portion of Coding or Identifier. The current search page states that modifiers are defined by the search-modifier-code CodeSystem, and source/fhir.ini actively includes the search-modifier-code value set that uses that code system. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-12-09 record FHIR-40842 being moved to Technical Correction and assigned for application.
reconciliation: Changed source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml so the code-text concept definition now uses the accepted wording: this modifier is used to do a 'standard' string search against code values.
source_changes: source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml: changed the code-text concept definition from display-text matching to standard string search against code values.

related_jiras.note: Established :code-text as a code/value-oriented modifier distinct from text/display-oriented matching.
